goal: Implement generated Orbit AI follow-up context over demonstration conversation data so the right-side panel resolves real relationship context.

success_criteria.description: The Orbit AI right-side panel no longer shows the text No mock chat conversation fixture matches that conversation id for seeded follow-up requests and instead resolves the intended contact, conversation, event, and schedule context.

The follow-up context service calls the configured agent-generation boundary with structured conversation and relationship inputs, and tests reject canned final-answer fixtures that bypass generation.

Ten named evaluation cases cover direct match, missing conversation, ambiguous person, stale relationship, recent event, pending reply, Chinese-language request, English-language request, schedule conflict, and privacy-limited context.
A repeatable design-evaluation-analysis loop records scoring thresholds and failing-case analysis in feature documentation, and the focused tests enforce the accepted threshold before UI success.
The mock-to-live replacement guidance documents conversation-data replacement, provider gating, prompt inputs, provenance requirements, and tests that keep generated context accurate.

out_of_scope: Returning prepared final answers instead of generated agent output
Calling external send or notification APIs
Changing conversation service contracts beyond typed inputs required by this sprint
